label: training-gym-r41-complete
context:
Training Gym R41 completed. All 4 exercises 10/10 (2 needed bug fixes).

R41 RESULTS (all 10/10):
1. rope-001 (T8) - Rope with split/concat/insert/delete, weight-based indexing. 5 tests. Clean.
2. veb-tree-001 (T9) - Van Emde Boas Tree with summary/cluster recursion. 5 tests. Clean.
3. wavelet-tree-001 (T8) - Wavelet Tree with bitvector binary partition. 5 tests. Bug: split on mid value caused infinite recursion — fixed by splitting alphabet at mid_idx.
4. minmax-heap-001 (T7) - Min-Max Heap with min/max level bubble-up. 5 tests. Bug: _parent(None) — fixed by checking parent before computing grandparent.

KEY PATTERNS:
- Rope: weight = left subtree total length, split returns (left_node, right_node)
- VEB: min stored separately, high/low split by sqrt(U), base case U<=2
- Wavelet Tree: split alphabet at mid_idx (not by value), left_alpha = set(alphabet[:mid_idx])
- Min-Max Heap: even depths are min levels, compare with grandparent on bubble-up, check parent != None first

DB: 238 exercises, 403 attempts, avg 9.87
4 clean rounds in last 5 (R38-R41). Coding accuracy strong.
decisions: Wavelet tree: split alphabet by INDEX not by VALUE to avoid infinite recursion when single element keeps going left
Min-Max heap: always check parent is not None before computing grandparent in bubble_up
VEB tree: min stored separately from clusters, cluster[high] created lazily
Rope: split at position i returns (left_node, right_node), handle edge cases where split creates empty side
next_steps: Design R42 exercises. Push to T9: Suffix Array + LCP, Treap, or Left-Leaning Red-Black Tree.
